title: Oxygen — Passenger Supply Duration and the Diversion Time Limitation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Limitation entry stating the passenger oxygen supply duration fitted to the aircraft, the escape profile it supports and the consequent limit on route planning over high terrain and long over-water sectors.

sections.purpose: To state the passenger oxygen supply duration for the standard fitted to the aircraft and the route planning limitation that follows from it.
sections.description: Passenger oxygen is supplied by a chemical generator in each service unit, and once started it runs for a fixed time that cannot be extended or stopped. Two standards are in service. The shorter standard supplies twelve minutes and the longer one twenty-two, and the standard fitted is recorded in the aircraft technical file and shown on the placard inside the service unit. The duration is what limits the escape profile after a depressurisation: the aircraft must be able to reach an altitude at which supplemental oxygen is no longer needed within the supply time, allowing for terrain and for the drift-down performance at the planned weight. Over high terrain and on long over-water sectors this is often the binding constraint on the route rather than fuel. A mixed installation within one service unit is prohibited, and an aircraft with any service unit at the shorter standard is treated as being at the shorter standard for planning purposes.
sections.crew_procedure: Before dispatch, confirm from the technical file which oxygen standard the aircraft carries and that the planned route has been assessed against it. On a route where the escape profile is close to the limit, brief the drift-down and the terrain escape track before departure. After a depressurisation, begin the descent immediately and follow the escape track that was briefed; do not plan the descent around the supply time in the moment, because the generator cannot be stopped once it has been started.
sections.limitation_note: Maximum diversion time and maximum escape profile duration after a depressurisation must not exceed the supply duration of the standard fitted, namely twelve minutes for the earlier generator and twenty-two minutes for the later one, with no allowance for partial deployment. An aircraft with any passenger service unit at the earlier standard is limited to twelve minutes.

type_data.crew_action: Confirm the oxygen standard fitted and that the route has been assessed against its supply duration.
